'''''Geranium pusillum''''', commonly known as '''small-flowered crane's-bill'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> or (in North America) '''small geranium''',<ref name=GEPU>{{PLANTS|id=GEPU2|taxon=Geranium pusillum|accessdate=19 January 2016}}</ref> is a herbaceous annual plant of the genus ''[[Geranium]]''.

Small geranium is native to Europe<ref name=Jepsom>{{cite web | url=http://ucjeps.berkeley.edu/cgi-bin/get_JM_treatment.pl?4416,4426,4435 | title=UC/JEPS: Jepson Manual treatment for GERANIUM pusillum }}</ref> but is introduced in almost every region of the USA and Canada,<ref name=GEPU/> where it is associated with [[Urban_ecology#Modification_of_land_and_waterways|ecologically disturbed sites]].<ref name=Jepsom/>
